races.paceDynamic: Goodie Girl is the lone pace-setter and will control this from the front, with Arcland and Cooladdi likely to track her early before the majority settle further back. With 11 of the 14 runners carrying hold-up or midfield styles, there will be minimal early pressure on the leader, allowing a steady tempo through the early stages. The race will develop into a typical stamina test where Goodie Girl sets sustainable fractions before the field converges from halfway onwards. This shape strongly favours the front-running Goodie Girl and prominent racers like Arcland who can stay close to the pace without having to come from too far back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Goodie Girl maintains her lead without serious pressure through the first mile.
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions for her stamina profile and prove hard to peg back when the field closes late. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up against a controlling leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Goodie Girl goes too fast early or gets headed before the home turn.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the fresher hold-up horses can unleash their kicks against tiring leaders. Those with tactical pace like Typical Thomas and strong finishes will benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midrace Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners challenge Goodie Girl simultaneously from halfway.
scenarios.body: This creates stop-start fractions that suit horses comfortable in traffic who can quicken when gaps appear. The tactical battle favours experienced campaigners with good positioning sense.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Slow Burn Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the entire field settles into a crawling pace behind an unchallenged Goodie Girl.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the final flight where natural speed trumps stamina. Those with the best turn of foot from unpromising positions can strike gold.

races.paceDynamic: Western Model leads alone from the front with Forever And A Day, Steps In The Sand, Hitthehayson and Mount Shenshan in the prominent group behind. The lack of genuine pace pressure allows Western Model to dictate a steady gallop over this stamina test, with the race likely developing into a tactical affair where positioning matters more than early speed. With 12 of 17 runners employing hold-up tactics, the finish will see waves of challengers but those who can secure good positions turning for home will have crucial advantages. This controlled pace scenario heavily favours prominent racers and front-runners who avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large pack of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Western Model gets an uncontested lead and maintains steady fractions throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to kick clear turning for home while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic. Prominent racers like Forever And A Day and Mount Shenshan can track the pace and respond when the sprint develops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Western Model sets honest pace but gets collared by a prominent runner in the straight
scenarios.body: The controlled gallop suits those positioned in second or third who can time their challenge perfectly without getting caught behind the wall of hold-up horses. Mount Shenshan and Forever And A Day are best positioned to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up horse gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: Nakassama or San Franco benefit from their class advantage if they can secure clear passages, but they need significant luck given the traffic problems likely ahead of them. The soft ground conditions could also play into their favour late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Western Model goes too slowly and multiple horses challenge simultaneously in a messy finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any of the better-handicapped horses could prevail if they avoid trouble, but this chaotic scenario typically favours those with tactical speed over pure stayers.

scenarios.trigger: If Lady Fromentro gets an easy lead and dictates sustainable fractions

races.paceDynamic: Leave In Secret will set the early pace from the front with minimal pressure in this 14-runner handicap chase. The majority of runners are prominent racers (Andys Flame, Dorking Cock, Freddie Robdal, Listentillitellyea) who will settle just behind the leader, creating a steady but not frantic gallop. With only two confirmed hold-up horses (Ringdufferin, Truckers Cruising), the pace will be honest but manageable over this staying trip. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace without getting into an early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Leave In Secret sets a steady pace without getting pressured early
scenarios.body: The prominent brigade of Andys Flame, Freddie Robdal and Dorking Cock can travel smoothly in behind before striking in the home straight. This controlled tempo plays into the hands of horses who need to be handy but don't want a furious gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: Ringdufferin and Truckers Cruising get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks from off the pace. The hold-up specialists can pick off tiring leaders who went too slow early doors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If Leave In Secret goes too slow and the race becomes a sprint from the last fence
scenarios.body: The better-handicapped horses with finishing speed like Finnians Row and Driveonwill can capitalize on a crawling pace. Fresh legs triumph over early positioning advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Leave In Secret gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to pressure him
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms throughout and prove hard to peg back up the run-in. Sometimes the obvious tactical move is the wrong move when everyone expects it.

races.paceDynamic: Saunton Surf is the only natural front runner in this field and should dictate terms from the start without any early pressure. The prominent runners Anodandawink, Schiehallion and Tropical Image will track behind, while the hold-up horses Coolboy Christy, Huntsgrove, Kalsman and Coppola will need to rely on the pace falling apart. With Saunton Surf able to bowl along at his own rhythm over this stamina test, the lack of pace pressure creates a tactical advantage for those who can travel in behind and finish strongly. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and strong finishers who can benefit from the controlled gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Saunton Surf sets an even gallop without serious challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of pace allows the back markers to close with devastating effect in the final half mile. Coolboy Christy and Kalsman can use their proven finishing kicks to maximum advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can stay close enough to Saunton Surf's steady pace
scenarios.body: Schiehallion or Tropical Image can kick clear before the hold-up horses fully wind up their runs. Their positioning advantage proves decisive in the run-in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Saunton Surf's 22-day break has him cherry ripe and the pace stays honest throughout
scenarios.body: He maintains his rhythm and has enough left to repel all challengers in the closing stages. His last win came from similar front running tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Saunton Surf goes too slowly and the field bunches up entering the straight
scenarios.body: A sprint finish develops where the handiest horse wins regardless of early position. This turns into a lottery finish with any runner capable.
